<h2>Load a Successful Model Target</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Loads a target only when its targets metadata records successful completion.
Read failures are represented by 'NULL'.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>.load_successful_model_target(
  data_meta,
  target_name,
  store_path,
  read_target_fn
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_meta">data_meta</code></td>
<td>
<p>Targets metadata containing target names and errors.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="target_name">target_name</code></td>
<td>
<p>Single target name to load.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="store_path">store_path</code></td>
<td>
<p>Targets store path.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="read_target_fn">read_target_fn</code></td>
<td>
<p>Function used to load the target.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>The loaded target object, or 'NULL'.
</p>

</main>
